## 2024-10-24 - Masking Sensitive Proxy Credentials in Console Outputs and Exception Tracebacks
**Vulnerability:** The application was logging clear-text proxy connection details (username/password) to the terminal, and printing stack traces generated by the `requests` library that revealed the proxy connection URL strings including passwords.
**Learning:** Exception handling paths often implicitly log internal parameters or state that contain sensitive connection information (like a password in an HTTP proxy connection string), bypassing typical variable-level redactions.
**Prevention:** Implement comprehensive regex scrubbing on all connection-related exception string representations before logging, encode special characters in usernames/passwords for URL constructions, and proactively mask explicit log messages containing credentials.
